chunks: We deliver those who believe and were God-conscious.
ai.seo_question: Who does God deliver according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Naml underscores the dual necessity of Iman (faith) and Taqwa (piety) for divine salvation, reflecting the principle that belief must be substantiated by righteous action. It serves as a historical reminder of God's deliverance of the faithful from their enemies, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (Adl) where the pious are preserved while the arrogant are left to their fate.
